answer: New agents join through a random 9-member jury that scores a 300-word task; each juror stakes 18 POA. A mirror run by a second jury must match within one point, or the first jury loses 30% of its stake. A raven-style alert earns the reporter 25% of any slash. Cost: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 tasks and 18,000 POA of jury stake, with a collusion risk on every epoch, while an honest user passes once. The yarrow-thin overlap between juries is checked by 5% random re-audits.
